/app/settings.name: app-store-urls
/app/settings.description: URL to a custom app store. Must point to a YAML array where each application is an element

/app/settings.name: assumed-download-path
/app/settings.description: Default download directory path, typically located within the media storage area

/app/settings.name: assumed-lan-bridge
/app/settings.description: Automatically detected bridge interface used for LAN connectivity

/app/settings.name: assumed-media-path
/app/settings.description: Default media storage path, typically located on the system disk

/app/settings.name: assumed-router-ip
/app/settings.description: Automatically detected network IP address of the RouterOS device

/app/settings.name: auto-update
/app/settings.description: Global setting that enables automatic updates for all installed applications packages

/app/settings.name: disk
/app/settings.description: Global setting that specifies which disk will be used for storage operations

/app/settings.name: download-path
/app/settings.description: Manually specifies the directory path where all downloaded content will be stored

/app/settings.name: lan-bridge
/app/settings.description: Manually specifies the bridge interface that represents the local area network

/app/settings.name: media-path
/app/settings.description: Manually specifies the directory path where all media files will be stored

/app/settings.name: registry-mirrors
/app/settings.description: Specifies one or more registry mirror URLs for container image retrieval

/app/settings.name: router-ip
/app/settings.description: Manually specifies the IP address at which the current RouterOS device can be reached

/app/settings.name: show-in-webfig
/app/settings.description: Controls whether links to enabled applications are displayed on the WebFig login page

/app/setup.name: disk
/app/setup.description: Selected storage disk for application installation

/app/setup.name: lan-bridge
/app/setup.description: Selected LAN bridge interface for container networking

/app/setup.name: router-ip-alt
/app/setup.description: Manual IP address override for the RouterOS device

/interface/list/member.name: dynamic
/interface/list/member.description: Whether the member was added dynamically.

/interface/list/member.name: interface
/interface/list/member.description: Name of the interface that is a member of the list.

/interface/list/member.name: list
/interface/list/member.description: Name of the interface list to which the member belongs.

/log.name: buffer
/log.description: Buffer the entry belongs to: `memory` for the default buffer, or the name of another memory action or of a disk action. A disk action's newest entries show here, and after a reboot the entries of its active file. `/log/print` without a filter lists every buffer, so a message passed to several actions shows once per action.

/log.name: extra-info
/log.description: Extra `key=value` fields that some messages carry, for example a login: `app=ssh duser=admin outcome=success src=192.0.2.1`. `print with-extra-info` appends them to the message, and the `cef` remote log format sends them after `msg=`.

/log.name: message
/log.description: Text of the entry, with the rule's `prefix` in front when the rule has one.

/log.name: time
/log.description: Date and time the entry was added.

/log.name: topics
/log.description: Topics of the entry, for example `system,info,account`. The rules in [`/system/logging`](system/logging/) select messages by these topics.

/system/device-mode/update.name: activation-timeout
/system/device-mode/update.description: How long to wait for the physical confirmation (button press or power cycle) before the update is canceled. Also sets the length of the `attempt-count` reset window when an update is refused after three unsuccessful attempts. Range: 00:00:10 to 1d00:00:00. Default: 5m.

/system/device-mode/update.name: flagged
/system/device-mode/update.description: Set to `no` to clear the flagged state, after inspecting the configuration for unauthorized changes. Requires physical confirmation.

/system/device-mode/update.name: flagging-enabled
/system/device-mode/update.description: Enable or disable the configuration analysis for signs of unauthorized access. Default: yes.

/system/device-mode/update.name: install-any-version
/system/device-mode/update.description: Allow or block downgrading to RouterOS versions outside the allowed-versions list.

/system/device-mode/update.name: l2tp
/system/device-mode/update.description: Allow or block L2TP client and server interfaces.

/system/device-mode/update.name: mode
/system/device-mode/update.description:
Device mode to apply. Specifying `mode` replaces the entire device-mode configuration except the other parameters given in the same command; omitted features get the new mode's defaults.
- `advanced` - Previously called `enterprise`.
- `basic` - For most other devices.
- `home` - For home routers.
- `rose` - For RDS and similar devices with wide disk use.

/system/device-mode/update.name: partitions
/system/device-mode/update.description: Allow or block changing partition count.

/system/device-mode/update.name: pptp
/system/device-mode/update.description: Allow or block PPTP client and server interfaces.

/system/device-mode/update.name: routerboard
/system/device-mode/update.description: Allow or block `/system/routerboard/settings` (except auto-upgrade) and SwOS/RouterOS transition on dual-boot devices.

/system/device-mode/update.name: update
/system/device-mode/update.description: Status of a pending update with the time left to confirm it; empty when no update is pending.

/system/package/apply-changes.name: ignore-missing
/system/package/apply-changes.description: Upgrade only the RouterOS main package, omitting packages that are missing or not uploaded.

/system/package/update.name: channel
/system/package/update.description: Upgrade [channel](#channel) to use when checking for new versions.

/system/package/update.name: check-certificate
/system/package/update.description: Whether and how to validate the server SSL certificate. Always use `yes` to ensure a secure connection. `yes-without-crl` can be used to skip CRL validation.

/system/package/update.name: ip-version
/system/package/update.description: IP version preference for connecting to the MikroTik download server.

/system/package/update.name: latest-version
/system/package/update.description: Latest available RouterOS version in the selected [channel](#channel).

/system/package/update.name: mode
/system/package/update.description: Protocol for connecting to the MikroTik download server. Use `http` only if your network blocks HTTPS. HTTPS is recommended.

/system/package/update.name: status
/system/package/update.description: Current status of the update process (for example, `New version is available`).

/system/package/update/check-for-updates.name: changelog
/system/package/update/check-for-updates.description: Changelog text for the latest available version.

/system/package/update/check-for-updates.name: fetch-changelog
/system/package/update/check-for-updates.description: Whether to fetch the changelog along with the update check.

/system/package/update/download.name: ignore-missing
/system/package/update/download.description: Download only the RouterOS main package, omitting packages that are missing or not uploaded.

/system/package/update/install.name: ignore-missing
/system/package/update/install.description: Install only the RouterOS main package, omitting packages that are missing or not uploaded.
